newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.4 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation unchanged at 0.4 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation was unchanged in the week ended November 25 at 0.4 percent, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
On present trends, inflation for the whole of November will be 1.9 percent, and the year-on-year rate in December will be 22 percent, it said. The monthly rate in October was 1.2 percent.
Inflation in the first 25 days of November was 1.5 percent, and since the beginning of this year prices have risen 19.7 percent.
